Hello, you've reached Sakura Say-koh-tsoo-in. This is the clinic's AI receptionist, speaking in English. How can I help you today?
Could you put me through to a staff member?
Of course. I can pass your details to our staff so they can call you back. May I have your name, please?
I'm sorry, I didn't quite catch that. Could you say it again, please?
I have something I want to talk about.
I understand. Could you please tell me what it's about?
Thank you. Just to confirm, your name is Yada. Is that correct?
Thank you, Shoji. May I have a phone number where our staff can reach you?
